title: Platform and Pipeline Support
lead: Technical support for setting up and operating DevOps platforms and CI/CD pipelines — enabling fast, safe software delivery.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Platform and Pipeline Support helps organisations implement the technical foundation for DevOps — the developer platform, CI/CD toolchain and deployment automation. This includes platform selection, setup, integration and ongoing operation. A well-designed platform is a force multiplier for development teams.

sections.heading: ITOM Perspective
sections.body: The DevOps platform is the technology backbone of a modern delivery operating model. In ITOM, platform and pipeline support translates the operating model design into a working technical environment — enabling the practices, governance and metrics defined in the operating model.

items.desc: Internal developer platform (IDP) setup — portals, self-service, scaffolding.
Design and implementation of build, test and deployment pipelines.
Automating infrastructure provisioning with tools like Terraform or Ansible.
Ongoing platform management, monitoring and evolution.
Embedding security controls into the pipeline (SAST, DAST, secrets management).
